The shift

From paperwork to live operational visibility.

Teams still run inspections, vehicles, equipment, permits, contractors and reports through disconnected paper, spreadsheets and separate tools. SafeTraQ QHSE brings them into one connected platform, so activity in the field becomes real-time visibility for management.

  • ✓Digital inspections replace paper & Excel
  • ✓Automatic reports, ready when audited
  • ✓Central records, defects, permits, compliance
  • ✓Live status across sites, assets & operations

Core value

Everything an inspection needs.

Digital Inspections

Complete inspections from phone, tablet or desktop, online or off, with photos and defects captured on the spot.

Automatic Reports

Generate a clean, formatted report straight from the completed inspection, ready to send or store.

Central Records

Keep inspections, defects and reports in one searchable place, ready when you are audited.

On-Site Construction

Plant, lifting and site inspections for busy construction sites, from cranes and telehandlers to access equipment.

Facilities & Utilities

Permit-controlled work, substation and plant checks with contractor and compliance records kept together.

Heavy Plant & Equipment

Operator pre-use checks and statutory inspections for excavators, loaders, crushers and production machinery.
